# Feature Design: Health Check

## Realization Overview

The API module exposes the health-check feature through its documented status contract.

## Module and Feature Collaboration

The API feature reads only its immediate dependency status and returns the contract-defined summary.

## Scenario Realization

The primary status scenario maps the request to the API module and its declared contract.

## Durable Implementation Decisions

The status calculation remains side-effect free.

## Traceability and Evidence

Acceptance coverage is maintained by the feature's contract and integration tests.

## Known Limitations

Dependency-specific diagnostics remain outside this feature.
